failures.question: 各仓库的库存周转情况：当前库存量、近 90 天出库量、库存周转天数分别是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_moved_at
  FROM inventory_movements
),
inv AS (
  SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outbound AS (
  SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS outbound_90d
  FROM inventory_movements im
  CROSS JOIN anchor a
  WHERE im.movement_type = 2
    AND im.moved_at >= a.max_moved_at - INTERVAL '90 days'
    AND im.moved_at <= a.max_moved_at
  GROUP BY im.warehouse_id
)
SELECT
  w.warehouse_id,
  COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock,
  COALESCE(outbound.outbound_90d, 0) AS outbound_90d,
  ROUND(90.0 * COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(outbound.outbound_90d, 0), 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound ON outbound.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_moved_at
  FROM inventory_movements
),
inv AS (
  SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outbound AS (
  SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS outbound_90d
  FROM inventory_movements im
  CROSS JOIN anchor a
  WHERE im.movement_type = 2
    AND im.moved_at >= a.max_moved_at - INTERVAL '90 days'
    AND im.moved_at <= a.max_moved_at
  GROUP BY im.warehouse_id
)
SELECT
  w.warehouse_id,
  COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock,
  COALESCE(outbound.outbound_90d, 0) AS outbound_90d,
  ROUND(90.0 * COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(outbound.outbound_90d, 0), 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound ON outbound.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;
